title: 第11章 金府风雨第12章 升级
slug: 玄幻我有机甲鬼才愿意去修仙
content_zh:
正午的金府，宛若是一间空宅，数百个下人被分开审问，往日热闹的宅子宛若是炼狱一般，炙热的空气熏烤着，让他们连大口喘息都没办法。
“白翠，你今日在金四小姐院里进出，做了什么？”
跪于地上的人瑟瑟发抖，因为眼前的人乃是金家四大恶人之一的林大。
他素来喜欢用最狠毒的手段去惩罚下人，落在其手里，哪怕是无罪都要脱层皮。
“林......副总管，奴.....奴婢的.....的.....”
林大看着后面黑压压好多人，想一个个都这样，别说晚饭，就是明天早饭都吃不上。
便用力拍了下惊堂木，可还没开口，白翠吓得头一歪直接晕死过去。
“废物，废物，拖下去，下一个。”
旁边的丫鬟们立即七手八脚将人抬到屋外的走廊上。
门外的人很清楚这李林大为人，若开口哪怕说一个字，轻则也得挨几巴掌。
排在队伍首位的迈过门槛走入屋内，面色如常。
“林副总管，奴婢是卯时刚过便去四小姐院内，衣物由阿兰姐拿出来，所以，奴婢不曾进入小姐闺房内。”
“你是未曾去过的，但也不表示之前你没有机会接触药丸。”
林大烦躁地挥了挥手。
旁边还有记录员老陆，一五一十全部记录在案，还包括今日穿着都细细记录。
“林总管，这样下去，恐怕再有几月都查不出。”
老陆上了年纪，本来早早吃了午饭，听说出事了，就赶紧过来帮忙。
“我知道，这件事不查清楚，别说午饭，就是往后都别想吃了。下一个。”
林大拍下惊堂木，抓了几片人参塞入嘴里，心想这样搞下去，吃再多人参都顶不了。
金府，怎么也有七八百人，几个总管各领一批人，今日问完了，明天估计又得重新问。

“林副总管，奴婢今日刚好休息，昨晚天黑后便回了家，早上才赶了回来。”
“下去。”
林大看了一眼旁边的老陆。
老陆匆匆记录完，眼珠一转，便有了注意，“林总管，不若先审问那些无人证者，如此一来......”
林大连连摆手，摇头晃脑道：“若想下毒，顷刻便可。”
“那让他们懂字的负责替他们记录，每人把昨日至今日的行踪说一遍，总管再逐一甄别便可。”
林大觉得可行，便让人传话下去。
守在门外的顿时如释重负，有的直接双腿一软坐到了地上。
在场的都清楚要找下毒的人那无疑是大海捞针，而他们都只是下等奴仆，想找机会接触药丸，根本不可能。
可主家要查，谁都不会逃不掉，要么乖乖配合，要么被当做嫌疑犯。
二选一，谁都没办法置身事外。
“老陆，你觉得这下毒人如何下毒的？”
林大拿起茶杯抿了一小口，一小片茶叶沾在嘴唇上，他不以为是的舔入嘴里细细嚼了起来，眼睛则盯着他陆。
老陆捻了捻胡须，压低声音道：“这丹乃是昨夜挑选，然后用蜡封瓶，这丹房是重地，纵然林总管要去，怕也不是轻而易举。”
林大也没托大，顶着副总管头衔，很多地方都不能随意出入。
“如此说来，能下毒的只有丹房里的人？”
“这倒未必，细心之人要潜入，总有机会，但丹房有金丹修士坐镇，要进去下毒，再全身而退，怕不是很容易。”
一小孩忽然从人群中钻出，大步走了进来，双腿一曲，跪在地上。
“林副总管，奴昨夜去茅厕，发现有个蒙面人进了炼丹房。”
“黑衣人？”

林大一听顿时来了精神，马上坐直了身体，摆出一副县老爷的样子。
“是，奴还闻到一股淡淡的香气，好像跟四小姐身上的气味差不多。”
这下麻烦了。
content_en:
At noon, the Jin Mansion seemed like an empty house. Hundreds of servants were being interrogated separately. The bustling house in the past seemed like purgatory. The scorching hot air made them unable to even take a deep breath.
"Bai Cui, what did you do when you came in and out of Miss Jin Si's courtyard today?"
The person kneeling on the ground was trembling, because the person in front of him was Lin Da, one of the four evil men of the Jin family.
He always likes to use the most cruel means to punish his servants. If he falls into his hands, even if he is innocent, he will be stripped of his skin.
"Lin...Deputy General Manager, slave...slave's...s..."
Lin Da looked at the crowds of people behind him and thought that if everyone was like this, they would not be able to eat breakfast tomorrow, let alone dinner.
He slapped the gavel hard, but before he could speak, Bai Cui was so frightened that her head tilted and she fainted.
"Trash, trash, drag it down, next one."
The maids nearby immediately carried the person to the corridor outside the house with all their hands.
The people outside the door knew very well that Li Lin was a big man, and if he spoke even one word, he would be slapped a few times.
The person at the head of the queue crossed the threshold and walked into the house, his expression as usual.
"Deputy Manager Lin, I went to the fourth lady's courtyard just after Mao Shi. Sister Alan took out the clothes, so I never entered the lady's boudoir."
"You've never been there before, but that doesn't mean you haven't had the opportunity to come into contact with pills before."
Lin Da waved his hand irritably.
There was also recorder Lao Lu beside him, who recorded everything in detail, including what he was wearing today.
"Manager Lin, if this continues, I'm afraid we won't be able to find out for a few more months."
Lao Lu was old and had had lunch early. When he heard that something had happened, he hurried over to help.
"I know. If we don't find out about this matter, let alone lunch, we won't even think about eating it from now on. Next one."
Lin Da took a picture of the gavel, grabbed a few slices of ginseng and stuffed it into his mouth, thinking that if he continued like this, no matter how much ginseng he ate, he wouldn't be able to cope with it.
There are seven to eight hundred people in the Jin Mansion, and several general managers each lead a group of people. I have finished asking questions today, and I will probably have to ask them again tomorrow.
"Deputy Manager Lin, I just had a rest today. I went home after dark last night and came back in the morning."
"Go down."
Lin Da glanced at Lao Lu next to him.
Lao Lu hurriedly finished recording, then rolled his eyes and paid attention, "Manager Lin, why don't we interrogate those who have no witnesses first, then..."
Lin Dalian waved his hands, shook his head and said: "If you want to poison, you can do it in an instant."
"Then let those who know how to read take charge of recording them for them. Everyone can tell their whereabouts from yesterday to today, and the manager will screen them one by one."
Lin Da thought it was feasible and asked someone to pass on the message.
Those guarding the door were suddenly relieved, and some of them sat down on the ground with their legs weak.
Everyone present knew that finding the person who poisoned the pill was undoubtedly a needle in a haystack, and since they were just low-level slaves, it was impossible to find an opportunity to come into contact with the pill.
But if the master wants to investigate, no one will be able to escape. They must either cooperate obediently or be treated as a suspect.
Choose one or the other, no one can stay out of it.
"Lao Lu, how do you think the poisoner poisoned him?"
Lin Da picked up the tea cup and took a sip. A small piece of tea leaf stuck to his lips. He licked it into his mouth and chewed it carefully, staring at him.
Lao Lu twirled his beard and lowered his voice: "I selected this elixir last night and sealed the bottle with wax. This elixir room is an important place. Even if Manager Lin wants to go, I'm afraid it won't be easy."
Mr. Lin didn't have any support. With the title of deputy general manager, he was not allowed to enter and leave at will in many places.
"So, the only people who can poison are the people in the alchemy room?"
"That's not necessarily true. If a careful person wants to sneak in, there is always a chance. But there are golden elixir monks in the alchemy room. It's not easy to go in and poison the place, and then escape unscathed."
A child suddenly emerged from the crowd and strode in. He bent his legs and knelt down.on the ground.
"Deputy Manager Lin, I went to the toilet last night and found a masked man entering the alchemy room."
"Men in black?"
Lin Da immediately became energetic when he heard this. He immediately sat up straight and acted like a county gentleman.
"Yes, I also smell a faint fragrance, which seems to be similar to the smell of Miss Fourth."
This is trouble.
